ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut. Gate spot-checked: SessionFrameCodec.durationNanoseconds guards with isFinite and a strict < Double(UInt64.max) check, saturating to .max (SessionTransport.swift:686-709), and both surviving conversion call sites route through it (ServiceSocketClient.swift:448, SessionIOQueue.swift:5). RuntimeReadiness.swift is gone and its successor forwards the Date deadline without numeric conversion.
